about.text: It is a washed curd, ripened cheese, from standardised and pasteurized milk. A variation of Danish danbo cheese. It is a matured cheese, of medium moisture and fat. Semi-hard, elastic consistency. Compact, smooth, not grainy texture. Uniform yellowish white colour. Lactic, smooth, slightly salty, characteristic flavor. This cheese comes in blocks which are salted, and surface dried. vacuum package

sources.text: PGI since 2017; Wikipedia gives 12-52 weeks (infobox 1.5-5 months); blocks ripen under a bacterial smear that is washed off before sale; mild to extra aged (Lillebror, Gamle Ole); PGI spec not read
